name: EWA World Championship
notes: The fed's own Championship Info board carried four topics in January 2007; none was captured.
epitaph: The fed's top belt, and the only one whose lineage the served record actually turns over. Commander D carried it into the Hell in a Cell main event of CAGED on 12 April 2008 and the Model left with it, then kept it four weeks later at Royal Demolitions by climbing a ladder and taking it down himself. Where the belt came from before that, and where it went after 29 May 2008, is not in the surviving record.

name: EWA Television Championship
epitaph: The Renagade held it across every card the record holds, defending it against King on 3 April 2008 and against Xero on 21 April. Its last appearance is a contradiction the fed left standing: the 29 May card bills a Television title match, and the ring announcer's own call names the winner Lightweight champion instead.

name: EWA Lightweight Championship
epitaph: Contested in an Ultimate Ladder match at Royal Demolitions on 10 May 2008 — four men, one belt overhead — and won by the Extreme Menace, who was still billed with it three weeks later. Its earlier lineage is not in the surviving record.

name: EWA World Tag Team Championship
notes: The fed's own commentary calls them the “EWA World Tag titles”; its cards bill the match as an “EWA Tag Team Match”.
epitaph: Vacated by order of the fed's own Chairman of the Board, who stripped the champions for refusing to defend the belts together, and settled the same night: a four-team Hell in a Cell at CAGED on 12 April 2008 that X-Rated won. The card's own action text credits the deciding fall to Phoenix, unbilled on any of the four teams -- the announcer's credit to X-Rated stands as the fed's own declared result.

name: EWA North American Championship
notes: Board topic 454, “EWA North American”, 12 August 2007 — indexed by title, date and starter on the forum's own listing, never captured.
epitaph: Andy held it through every card the record holds, defending it inside a cage against the Television champion at CAGED and again against “The Real Deal” Jimmy Steele at Royal Demolitions. A topic of its own name was opened on the board's off-topic forum in August 2007, nine months before the first held card.

name: EWA Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Decided in a three-way Falls Count Anywhere Hardcore Brawl at Royal Demolitions on 10 May 2008, where Red Steel beat the Television champion and the Dark Angel for it. It appears nowhere else in the surviving record.
